messages:
tess: Quick flag: noticed invoice preview for tenant X dropped ~8% vs raw ledger for hour window 01:00-02:00 UTC. preview shows lower quota usage than ledger. anyone else seeing similar?
rick: saw a small blip on the quota-watermark dashboard. looks like some hourly rollups skipped a window during route-resolver restart at 01:12
maya: timeline: route-resolver restart coincided with a rolling quota update (we changed per-route soft caps). some metering events arrived with quota_tag=null for ~2 minutes, aggregator treats null tag as 'default' and that default is excluded from preview query by mistake
tess: so preview filters out default tag but ledger keeps raw events -> mismatch
zara: short-term mit: make preview query include default tag until we fix upstream. long-term: ensure aggregator emits explicit quota_tag="unset" instead of null to avoid ambiguity
rick: agree. also need to check watermarking: our hourly watermark agent skips windows with missing quota_tag to avoid double-counting; that logic is now excluding legitimate tokens
maya: ops-bot: filing ticket MET-2022 to track (preview filter + aggregator null handling)
ops-bot: MET-2022 created by maya: "billing: handle null quota_tag during rolling quota changes; ensure preview includes default temporarily". priority P2
zara: mitigation plan: 1) quick query change in preview service to include NULL quota_tag for 2h canary 2) aggregator patch to normalize null -> "unset" 3) add metric "quota_tag_null_rate" and dashboard card 4) backfill job to re-run rollups for affected hour if needed
tess: canary cohort: 50 tenants spread across regions, start 04:00 UTC for 90m. I'll own cohort and validation metrics
rick: aggregator PR will add explicit tag emission. I'll own PR and staging canary today
maya: preview PR owned by kevin? (cc kevin) If not available, I can do small query tweak
ops-bot: MET-2022 updated: owners tess (cohort), rick (aggregator PR), maya (preview tweak), zara (backfill job). scheduled canary 04:00 UTC
zara: note: add runbook step: when doing quota changes coordinate with route-resolver restarts and set maintenance flag so preview ignores transient nulls automatically
rick: also measure latency impact of extra tag normalization in aggregator, but should be minimal
tess: ok team, will post canary results in MET-2022 and update console card if we need to surface "quota attribution confidence"
ops-bot: reminder scheduled: MET-2022 canary kickoff 04:00 UTC
